queries.sql:
SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code LIKE 'rev-%' AND version_id = 3 AND fiscal_year = 2026 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_net_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code LIKE 'rev-%' AND version_id = 2 AND fiscal_year = 2026 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS aop_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code LIKE 'rev-%' AND version_id = 1 AND fiscal_year = 2025 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS prior_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code LIKE 'cogs-%' AND version_id = 3 AND fiscal_year = 2026 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_cogs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code LIKE 'opex-%' AND version_id = 3 AND fiscal_year = 2026 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_opex,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code LIKE 'da-%' AND version_id = 3 AND fiscal_year = 2026 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_da
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED
      WHERE module IN ('revenue','cogs','opex','da')
        AND dim_primary != 'ALL'

      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED
      WHERE version_id = 3 AND fiscal_year = 2026 AND module = 'revenue' AND account_code LIKE 'rev-%'
        AND dim_primary != 'ALL'
      GROUP BY period ORDER BY period
